manual_scope_review: Cash includes initial capital; labels distinguish cash, income, savings, earmarks and observed capability gain.
Hypothesis and 4x demand curves are explicitly unvalidated simulations.
Settlement atomic quantities use the declared asset decimals; Jobs escrow includes its added fee, while Manager uses gross escrow.
Settlement bars are cash after worker gas but before enterprise delivery, setup, labor, taxes and reserves; the figure explicitly says receipts are not profit.
The hypothetical token price and missing on-chain execution are prominent. Source hyperlinks point to pinned implementation sources.
selection: Four explicitly selected base USD20/50% cash cases; all three settlement routes and realization assumptions at the USD20 illustrative quote. No new financial scenario was evaluated.
